summary: Configured and validated node1 as the writable PostgreSQL primary with node2 and node3 as read-only streaming standbys. Replication is SCRAM-authenticated, listener/firewall access is restricted to the dedicated cluster network, and services/configuration are enabled for boot persistence.
actions_performed: Verified streaming replication and committed data on both standbys.
Validated persistent network, HBA, slot, passfile, and firewall configuration.
Did not reboot nodes; independent evaluator owns reboot testing.
